data.name: Aqleem
data.gender_notes: Aqleem is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'aqal', Aqleem signifies someone who is intelligent and wise. It is a unisex name, given to both boys and girls. The name Aqleem carries the meaning “Learned, Wise” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Aqleem usually hope their child will grow to embody learned, wise and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of wisdom and knowledge, Aqleem reminds us of the importance of seeking knowledge and using it to better ourselves and the world around us.
data.etymology: Aqleem belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Learned, Wise.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aqleem total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: أَقْلِيم
in_arabic.meaning: الاسم يرمز إلى الشخص البالغ ذو العقل الحكيم
in_arabic.long_meaning: يُنْبَطِعُ أَقْلِيمُ مِنْ رَوْعِ الْعَرَبِيّ وَيَعْنِي الْعَقْلِ وَالْحِكْمَةِ. لَا يَجْدُ مِنْهُ ذِكْرَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ، وَلَكِنْ يَجْدُ إِسْمُهُ فِي الْبِرْهَانِ لِفُقَاهَةِ الرَّحْبَانِيَّ، وَفِي مُسْتَخْرَجَةِ أَسْماءِ الْعَرَبِيَّةِ. يُحَدَّثُ أَنَّهُ إِسْمٌ سَمِعَتْ بِهِ مِنْ قَوْمِ الْعَجْمِ، وَأَنَّهُ إِسْمٌ مَعْرُوفٌ فِي الْعَشِيرِ الْأَوَّلِ مِنْ الْوَقْتِ الْعَرَبِيِّ.

in_urdu.name: اقْلِیم
in_urdu.meaning: اسمِ کا مطلب ہے بالغ عقلمند شخص
in_urdu.long_meaning: اقْلِیم، ایک عربی اسم ہے جو 'عقل' اور 'حِکْمَة' سے منسوب ہے۔ یہ قرآن میں نہیں ملتا، لیکن اس کا تذکرہ برہانِ فوqaہِ رَحْبَانِی اور مُستَخْرَجَةِ أَسْمَاءِ الْعَرَبیَّة میں ملتا ہے۔ کہا جاتا ہے کہ یہ نام قدیم عجم قوم کی طرف سے بھی استعمال کیا جاتا تھا۔ یہ قدیم عرب دور میں بھی ایک معروف نام تھا۔

in_hindi.name: अक़्लीम
in_hindi.meaning: बुद्धिमान और परिपक्व व्यक्ति का नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: अक़्लीम एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ 'बुद्धि' और 'विद्या' है। यह कुरान में नहीं पाया जाता है, लेकिन यह 'बरहानुल फूकहा राहमानी' और 'मुस्तख़रज अस्माए अरबी' जैसे ग्रंथों में उल्लेखित है। कहा जाता है कि यह नाम प्राचीन अरब और अजम कबीलों में भी प्रचलित था। यह नाम हिन्दूस्तानी मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी प्रचलित है।

in_pashto.name: اقلم
in_pashto.meaning: شخص، کې د انېلې او د حکمت له
in_pashto.long_meaning: اقلم، د عربي ژبه څخه راځي او د عقل او حکمت ته وړانديزي کوي. په قرآن کې د نوم یادونه نه دی، ځکه په برهان ل فوqaہِ رَحْبَانِی او په مستخرجه اسماए عربې کې یادونه شوی دی. په دې نوم ته د ډېرې نورې ژبو او ملګرو کې هم اړتښتې دی.

in_english.name: Aqleem
in_english.meaning: Name signifying a mature and intelligent person
in_english.long_meaning: Aqleem, an Arabic name derived from the root 'qlm,' meaning 'knowledge' or 'wisdom.' It doesn't directly appear in the Quran, but its etymology points to the highly valued qualities of intellect and understanding in Islamic tradition. While not a commonly found name in the Quranic narratives, it resonates with the Islamic emphasis on knowledge acquisition and intellectual growth. Aqleem carries connotations of maturity, wisdom, and sound judgment.

data.cultural_impact: The name Aqleem holds a significant impact in Islamic culture, as intelligence and wisdom are cherished qualities. In Islamic society, respect is given to knowledgeable individuals and scholars, who are appreciated for their wisdom and ability to impart knowledge to others. The name Aqleem reflects this cultural appreciation for intelligence and knowledge, and can be a source of pride and motivation for individuals who bear this name.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aqleem holds deep significance. In Islamic teachings, wisdom and intelligence are considered essential traits for a true believer. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) once said, "Seeking knowledge is a duty on every Muslim." (Bukhari and Muslim). The name Aqleem, therefore, represents a spiritual commitment to learning and acquiring knowledge, which can lead to a deeper understanding of God and His teachings. Furthermore, being intelligent and wise means being able to discern right from wrong, good from bad, and making sound decisions based on Islamic principles. Ultimately, the spiritual significance of the name Aqleem is tied to the broader Islamic values of knowledge, wisdom, and intellectual growth.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Aqleem signifies one who is approved or accepted by Allah. It symbolizes a person who is striving for righteousness and pleasing Allah in all aspects of their life. The name is derived from the Arabic word "Qalima" meaning agreement or covenant, emphasizing one's commitment to the divine contract between Allah and the believer.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aqleem ibn Abi Talib was a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Aqleem carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Aqleem was a prominent companion of the Prophet Muhammad and is mentioned in various hadiths and historical texts.

trends: Aqleem is a popular name in the Muslim world.
Aqleem is sometimes used as a given name in non-Muslim communities.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Aqleem remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Maryam Aqleem in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Aqleem, which means "Learned, Wise". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
